redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official standards, guides, pages, services or viewers retained as references; access does not imply row or redistribution rights.
An exact artifact whose dataset-specific licence permits recorded fields and derivatives, with owner, edition, coverage, schema, CRS, validity, attribution and digest pinned.
Registered, request-delivered, licensed or restricted material used and redistributed only as specifically permitted.
Personal, query, unclear-license, app-only, viewer-only or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.provider: Universal Postal Union with Egypt Post
sources.production_scope: The July 2023 sheet defines seven digits and province, locality, neighbourhood and community positions. It supplies no current assignment table, historical crosswalk, official surface or building relation.

sources.provider: Egypt Post General Department of GIS, hosted by Egyptian Tax Authority
sources.production_scope: The guide documents app-based GPS or structured-address lookup. A pinned response may validate its returned code and address at capture time; the guide supplies no reusable rows, polygon, app licence or bulk endpoint.
A pinned Egypt Post-controlled record may validate its stated office, service or postcode for capture time. Completeness, history, geometry and redistribution require separate proof.

sources.provider: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics
sources.production_scope: CAPMAS documents GIS services at administrative and building levels. Service descriptions and free map viewing do not publish a reusable nationwide address-building register or postal geometry; exact product licence and edition are required.

The authority and geoportal provide survey, cadastral and topographic context. Exact product, permission, copyright, terms, edition, coverage, CRS and digest must be pinned; portal visibility is not feature reuse.
Community data may generate candidates only. Its format generation, Egypt Post provenance, freshness, licence and old-to-new crosswalk must be proven before any reusable field is accepted.

artifact_partitions.contents: Pinned Egypt Post code and province/locality/neighbourhood/community components with validity and lineage.
Authoritative old-to-new aliases with both formats and validity; no padding or truncation.
Permitted pinned GPS/address lookup points separate from postal surfaces and exact buildings.
Optional versioned, uncertainty-bearing, non-canonical surfaces from rights-cleared inputs.
Civic address evidence and exact rights-cleared building joins separate from postcode membership.
Separately licensed CAPMAS, governorate and Survey Authority context with source CRS and edition.
Recipients, contacts, saved locations, correspondence, residence, ownership and query evidence excluded from public artifacts.
